description: This file defines the AppLockManager class, responsible for managing application lock/unlock states, handling biometric authentication, and controlling app lock behavior in a Swift-based iOS application.

classes.name: AppLockManager
classes.description: A final class conforming to ObservableObject that manages app lock state and authentication logic.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the app UI, requiring authentication to unlock.

methods.name: unlockWithoutPrompt
methods.description: Unlocks the app UI without user prompt, typically used post-logout.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to authenticate the user biometrically or via passcode; unlocks the app on success.

methods.name: lockAndRequireAuthIfNeeded
methods.description: Locks the app and prompts for authentication if enabled, typically called when returning to foreground.
